actionClasses: EnvSeal run with secret injection command
description: Reviews EnvSeal CLI commands that inject decrypted secrets into a child process, revoke recipient access and re-encrypt the vault, or rotate the vault encryption key. Read-only inventory commands (list, recipient ls) are not covered and remain automatic.
name: EnvSeal command protection
saferAlternatives: Use envseal list and envseal recipient ls for read-only inventory without side effects.
Review recipient and rotation changes before applying them to a shared vault.
